name: PostgreSQL
note: Used from Red Hat, pinned by digest, instead of a build of ours (ADR-002 rule 1). It is scanned here with grype, because the scanner of our build gate, trivy, cannot read its packages. Tried on 2026-11-28: it runs under restricted pod security with a read-only root filesystem as its own user (UID 999); as an arbitrary UID it also needs a passwd entry for that UID.
